conviction_note: Nothing unpriced at company level: Bonheur gives no guidance and has not pre-released Q3. The only lean is public Q3 power prices against a consensus EPS bar that was cut about 8% in the last month (10.34 to 9.49 NOK), so the stock gets 4.0% abs move at p_up 54. findings.finding: Swedish spot prices in the price areas where Bonheur's Scandinavian farms sit roughly doubled YoY in Q3 2026. SE2 averaged about 47 öre/kWh against about 23, and SE1 about 42 against 23 (Jul/Aug/Sep 2026: SE2 21.6/55.2/64.3 against 19.9/28.8/20.4 in 2025). UK day-ahead baseload printed £108-143/MWh in late July and August 2026. In Q3 2025 the Swedish farms were curtailed on low prices and Renewables EBITDA was only NOK 219m, so the segment should be up YoY. Offsets: 75% of Paul's Hill and Crystal Rig III output is hedged at £81-84, and Mid Hill was out until late August.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2 2026 Renewables EBITDA nearly doubled on the same price driver and the stock fell 2.73% on the day, because Wind Service and net profit were down. In Q3 2025 a Wind Service-led beat (EPS 10.8 against 5.9) rose 5.15%.
findings.original_quote: september 2026 var snittpriset 57,4 öre/kWh i SE1, 64,3 i SE2, 109,1 i SE3 och 150,2 i SE4, med moms (translation: in September 2026 the average price was 57.4 öre/kWh in SE1, 64.3 in SE2, 109.1 in SE3 and 150.2 in SE4, including VAT)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Power prices are public daily, and the three analysts model them. If the market had fully reflected this, the consensus EPS would not have been cut 8% in the past month. The cut points to the street marking down Wind Service or the minority share rather than raising Renewables, so a Renewables beat could still surprise slightly. The +15% move since July (219.5 to 253.5) suggests much of the price tailwind is already in the stock.

findings.finding: Wind Service faces a strong comparison: Q3 2025 EBITDA was NOK 577m. The Q2 2026 report said Blue Tern was 'currently idle' after its NNG campaign, and Q2 carried accruals for Brave Tern incident costs. Since February 2026, MEAG's 17.05% minority stake in Windcarrier also cuts the parent's share of this segment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Wind Service drove both of the largest reactions on record. Q3 2025, EBITDA 577m against 435m, rose 5.15%. Q2 2026, EBITDA 326m against 584m, fell 2.73%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. Blue Tern's idle status and the MEAG minority stake were disclosed months ago. The consensus EPS of 9.49 already sits below last year's 10.8, and was cut over the last 30 days, which is how the street prices a weaker Wind Service. The remaining unknown is Blue Tern's Q3 utilisation, for which nothing public was found.

findings.finding: On 23 September Bonheur placed an oversubscribed NOK 800m 6-year green bond at NIBOR + 2.15% to refinance intercompany green-project debt (Windy Standard III and others). This is cheap, routine funding, not distress.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025 NOK 700m green bond was followed by the Q3 2025 print, which rose 5.15%, but the bond was not the driver. No measurable reaction to financing in this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Public for five weeks. It matters only in that the Q3 balance sheet will show the refinancing and no distress signal.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is near zero (+0.08; truncated zero short, 20d run-up -1.6%, 60d +8.6%). The mild positive lean from power prices neither confirms nor fights it, but the +15% rally since July has probably already captured most of that tailwind.
language_note: The Swedish monthly spot-price series (boio.se, SE1/SE2 by month) gave the dated independent number for the Scandinavian wind farms. English sources gave only household-bill anecdotes or nothing for Q3 2026.

Norwegian-language NewsWeb filings (flaggemelding, rentefastsettelse, the Norwegian bond-listing notice) carried nothing the parallel English releases did not. Bonheur publishes its results in English only.
Norwegian press (e24, Finansavisen) yielded no Q3 preview or company-specific item in October 2026.
lessons_applied: Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis: cut the power-price finding from +0.5 to +0.4. It is not dropped, because the company's own Q2 statement ties this driver to segment EBITDA.
A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth about 0: cut the Wind Service finding from -0.3 to -0.2, because Blue Tern idle and the MEAG minority stake were disclosed in Q2/Q1.
Financing is a question: the bond is a cheap, oversubscribed refinancing, so it moved from +0.1 to +0.05.

Considered raising abs_move_pct on 'the numbers are new' (7.4%) and decided against it, because 'guidance none' measured 2.3% and this name never guides. Kept 4.0, deliberately not capped at the name's own reaction history (median about 1.5%, max 5.15%).
